name: gr1_scenes
rule: For each task, seeds 0, 1, 2, ... are checked in order, and the first 20 seeds are kept in which, right after the reset and before any physics step, no robot geometry (arm links and hand geometry) is in contact (distance < 0) with a scene object, container, or fixture. Scenes with such an overlap are excluded because a held robot cannot stay free of contact in them.
scene_seed: environment seed = 20261105 + 1000 * task + seed; global index g = 300000 + 1000 * task + seed
